translations.translatedText: # Wednesday 24.11.2021 (radio)
Corona deaths. Sweden's new prime minister. Germany's new government. Turku's Christmas tree. Polar night in Nuorgam. Thursday's weather.
## Corona deaths

![Corona testing sign at the HUS Meilahti hospital area.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_2606,h_1465,x_193,y_83/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-8810516196222427893/1637931680)
Open image viewer
Photo: Markku Ulander / Lehtikuva
Corona deaths have increased in Finland.
On Wednesday it was reported that there are 39 new corona deaths. Some deaths from October and November have also been counted.
Most of the dead are elderly people.
In total, 1302 people have died of corona in Finland.
On Wednesday it was also reported that there are about 1000 new corona infections.
## Sweden's prime minister
![Magdalena Andersson walking in a corridor](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5808,h_3267,x_0,y_269/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-882265619b85d0a203b/1637582310)
Open image viewer
Magdalena Andersson is Sweden's new prime minister. Photo: EPA-EFE/All Over Press
Finland's neighbour Sweden is getting a new prime minister. The new prime minister is Magdalena Andersson.
Andersson is the leader of the Social Democrats. Until now she has been Sweden's finance minister.
Magdalena Andersson is the first woman to become prime minister of Sweden.
## Germany's government
![Germany's government talks](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1600,h_900,x_0,y_96/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-8678626169a9736dab1/1635261552)
Open image viewer
The leaders of Germany's Greens, Social Democrats and Liberals negotiated about the government. Photo: EPA-EFE
Germany, the largest country in the European Union, is also getting a new prime minister. The job of prime minister, that is chancellor, will go to Olaf Scholz.
Scholz is a Social Democrat. The Social Democrats agreed on a government with the Greens and the Liberals. The parties still have to officially approve the agreement.
## Turku's Christmas tree
![A spruce in the early morning twilight](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3648,h_2052,x_0,y_46/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-883059619ddbaa10400/1637735415)
Open image viewer
The spruce for Turku Cathedral was found this year in Säkylä. Photo: Arash Matin / Yle
The Christmas tree for Turku Cathedral is in place. The spruce was brought in front of the cathedral on Wednesday.
The spruce was brought from Säkylä. It grew in the yard of Jarkko Karjalainen. In Karjalainen's opinion, giving the spruce was a great honour.
In the opinion of Finns, the Christmas tree of Turku Cathedral is Finland's number one tree. This year's tree is 23 metres tall.
The lights of the Christmas tree will be lit on Saturday. More than 700 lamps shine on the branches of the Christmas tree.
The Christmas tree and its lights have decorated Turku Cathedral for many years. The custom began more than 100 years ago, at the start of the 1900s.
## Polar night in Nuorgam
![Light of the polar night over Lake Pulmanki in Utsjoki](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3821,h_2149,x_0,y_9/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-883234619e1f8ea1185/1637752820)
Open image viewer
During the polar night the days are beautifully dim. Photo: Tapani Leisti / Yle
The polar night has started in Nuorgam, the northernmost village in Finland. During the polar night the sun does not rise in the sky.
On Wednesday the sun was in the sky over Nuorgam for the last time before the middle of January.
The polar night lasts more than 50 days in Nuorgam. The sun will rise in the sky again only on 17 January.
## Thursday's weather
![weather map](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12202338)
Open image viewer
On Thursday heavy snowfall moves across the middle of the country.
In the southern part of the country there will be a little rain in the daytime. In the northern part of the country the weather is dry.
In the southern part of the country it is warm, 1 to 5 degrees. Elsewhere it is frosty. In Lapland the frost is as much as 15 to 25 degrees.
The weather is also windy on Thursday.
